question: In which year did India and Maldives sign a trade agreement which provides for export of vital commodities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1981**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India and Maldives signed the trade agreement in the year **1981**.
 
• The agreement was significant as it focused on the **export of vital commodities** between the two nations.
 
• This agreement marked an important step in enhancing **economic cooperation** between India and Maldives.
 
• It helped in strengthening the bilateral relations and ensured the supply of essential goods, promoting mutual benefit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Trade Agreements**

 
 
• Trade agreements are treaties signed between countries to facilitate trade and economic cooperation.
 
• These agreements often include provisions for the reduction or elimination of tariffs, quotas, and other trade barriers.
 
• They aim to promote free trade and economic integration among the signatory countries.
 
• Examples of trade agreements include the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) and the European Union (EU) Single Market.
 
 
 
• **Bilateral Relations**
 
 
• Bilateral relations refer to the political, economic, and cultural relations between two sovereign states.
 
• These relations can encompass various aspects, including trade, defense, education, and tourism.
 
• Strong bilateral relations often lead to mutual benefits and enhanced cooperation between the countries involved.
 
• India has established strong bilateral relations with many countries, including the Maldives, through various agreements and partnerships.
 
 
 
• **Economic Cooperation**
 
 
• Economic cooperation involves collaboration between countries to improve economic ties and achieve common economic goals.
 
• This can include joint ventures, trade agreements, investment treaties, and shared development projects.
 
• Economic cooperation can lead to increased trade, investment, and economic growth for the participating countries.
 
• India and Maldives have engaged in economic cooperation through agreements like the 1981 trade agreement.
 
 
 
• **Export of Vital Commodities**
 
 
• Vital commodities refer to essential goods that are crucial for the survival and well-being of a population.
 
• This can include food, fuel, medicines, and other necessary items.
 
• Exporting vital commodities helps in meeting the needs of countries that may lack sufficient resources domestically.
 
• The 1981 trade agreement between India and Maldives facilitated the export of such essential goods, ensuring their availability in the Maldives.
